sha.description: The full 40-character head SHA that was reviewed.

reviewed_range.description: The git range actually read, e.g. <merge-base>..<head> or <old>..<head>.

complete.description: False when the diff could not be reviewed in full.

summary.description: At most 8 sentences: what changed, what was checked, why the verdict.

detail.description: Why it matters and a concrete failure scenario or reproducer.

owner_actions.description: The owner's four kinds this PR touches (owner 15-16.11.2026); empty when none. A review never sends anything else to the owner.

kind.description: cost_access: cost, a new service or new access; release: shipping to real users; sensitive_copy: privacy/consent/crisis/safety text a user can see; data_collection: switching on collection of new personal data.

evidence.description: file:line and why, synthetic wording only.

blocks.description: merge: the owner approves before merge; release: may merge, approved before release (only sensitive_copy kept pending).
